[EVENT] User is looking for suggestions on how to make a good raita to go with the Indian-Style Quinoa Bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basic Raita Recipe: 1 cup plain vegan yogurt, 1/2 cup diced cucumber, 1/4 cup diced red onion, 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional), 2 tablespoons lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for Raita: Use organic vegan yogurt, adjust cayenne pepper for spiciness, use European cucumber, choose onion type based on preference, add cilantro, and consider adding ground coriander or garam masala.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Raita assembly instructions: Combine ingredients, refrigerate for 30 minutes, stir in lemon juice, and serve chilled.  
[PREFERENCE] User is excited to try out the raita recipe.  
[EVENT] User has been meaning to get new spices and seasonings.  
[PREFERENCE] User needs to restock on turmeric and cumin after making the vegan quinoa bowl.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for turmeric: Look for organic, non-irradiated, high-curcumin
